name: Fraud Management Portal
description: Sherlock – our ready-to-go fraud management system that spots and stops threats in real time, keeping you a step ahead and your business secure.

features.name: Transaction Monitoring
features.description: This module continuously monitors real-time transactions to detect suspicious activity. It uses both rule-based logic and a machine learning model trained on localized Sri Lankan transaction data. The model continues to learn and adapt over time based on operational feedback. Upon detecting potential fraud, the system can trigger actions such as notifying the customer, blocking the transaction, or initiating additional verification like OTP or selfie spot check.

features.name: Rule-Based Configuration
features.description: This is the admin-facing module where business users can define and manage fraud detection rules. It allows the configuration of thresholds, alerts, and other business logic to tailor detection capabilities based on risk appetite and operational needs. Rules can be modified dynamically without requiring code-level changes, offering high flexibility and control.

features.name: xAI Module
features.description:
The Explainable AI (xAI) module offers transparency into the machine learning model’s decision-making process. It allows administrators to: 
   • View the classification result of each transaction (e.g., flagged as fraudulent or safe) 
   • Understand the rationale behind each decision 
   • Review feature importance/weights used by the model for each transaction This promotes accountability and helps regulatory or compliance teams audit AI-driven decisions.

features.name: Enhancement to eKYC Registration
features.description:
This module strengthens the eKYC (electronic Know Your Customer) process by displaying: 
   • The customer’s National Identity Card (NIC) 
   • Profile photo 
   • Any relevant background check data 
This ensures higher accuracy in identity verification and helps prevent identity fraud during user onboarding.

features.name: Mobile SDK for Behavioral Analysis
features.description:
This Software Development Kit (SDK) is integrated into mobile applications to collect behavioral and device-level data. It captures mobile parameters like: 
   • Device fingerprinting 
   • User typing patterns 
   • App usage behavior 
 This behavioral data helps in detecting anomalies that may indicate fraudulent activities, particularly on mobile platforms.

benefits.name: Prevent Transaction Fraud in Real-Time
benefits.description: Instantly detect and block suspicious activities, addressing customers' fears of unauthorized transactions and safeguarding financial integrity.

benefits.name: Strengthen Customer Trust
benefits.description: Secure every customer interaction by providing robust fraud protection, directly addressing trust issues prevalent in digital financial transactions.

benefits.name: Improve Transaction Transparency
benefits.description: Offer clear, detailed insights into every transaction, addressing customer uncertainty and fostering stronger customer-institution relationships through transparency.
